title: Career Assistant
subtitle: Your AI career copilot: build your profile from your CV, pull jobs from any alert, see how well each one fits, and draft tailored applications. You stay in control; nothing is sent.
chooseOrg: Choose a workspace to open your private career assistant.
summary: Professional summary (only facts you can support)
keywordsHint: Type a term and press Enter. Matching uses exact terms: add English and Arabic variants. Language checks currently recognise English names.
gmailDescription: Read LinkedIn and Indeed alerts from the last 14 days. Flow does not send applications or modify email.
gmailNotConfigured: Gmail is not configured on this server. You can import alert text below.
connected: Gmail connected. Choose Sync now or enable daily sync.
consentDenied: Gmail permission was declined or the callback is incomplete. Try connecting again.
dailySync: Enable a daily inbox check and in-app notification
pasteHint: Paste a LinkedIn or Indeed alert, a job post, or a message listing openings.
imported: Imported {{count}} new jobs. Existing jobs were preserved.
rankingNote: The score measures keyword evidence and known gaps, not acceptance probability. Missing requirements need review. OTE, estimates and unknown salary periods do not receive salary points.
empty: No jobs in this view. Import an alert or sync Gmail to start.
noEvidence: No explicit keyword match yet. Add your profile or check the full listing.
draftNote: Review every statement, replace your name and attach your CV yourself. Nothing has been sent.

salaryKind.listed_unverified: Listed amount — confirm guaranteed pay with employer
salaryKind.commission_or_ote: Commission / target earnings — not guaranteed salary

unparsed: {{count}} messages had no supported job links; review the original alerts.
aiProfileTitle: Build your profile from your CV
aiProfileHint: Paste your CV or a few lines about your experience. AI fills in the fields below using only terms found in your text. Review them, then save.
cvPlaceholder: e.g. Sales Executive at Example Foods, 2020–2024. Skills: Zoho Books, key accounts. Languages: English, Arabic.
aiFilled: AI suggestions added. Review them, then save your profile.
aiFailed: AI couldn't produce a reliable result. Nothing was changed. Please retry.
aiQuota: Your organization's AI usage limit is reached. Check Billing to continue.
pasteAiNote: Supported alerts are read directly. For any other text, AI finds the openings; details are always taken from your text.
importedAi: AI found and added {{count}} new jobs from your text.
fitStale: Your profile changed since this analysis. Refresh it for an up-to-date view.
fitNote: AI-generated from your profile and this listing. Not a prediction of the hiring outcome.
fitIntro: Get an AI explanation of how your profile fits this job and what to confirm.
